# NES asset catalogue (Phase 1b) - generated by tools/catalog_nes.py; do not edit

One record per game object of the NES/Famicom Gradius games, identified in the running game
(OAM entries pixel-verified against the frame, object slots and code in RAM) with tiles, layout and
NES palette indices per frame. No ROM bytes: CHR and captures are private. Method: docs/CATALOG_METHOD.md.

### Gradius (NES US / Famicom JP) gaps

- {"id": "gap.unused_metasprites", "what": "Metasprites $09, $0B and $9F", "status": "catalogued as gr.unused.* (excluded: unused)", "reason": "Defined in the table at $8D9E/$8E9E but no code path found writes these ids and no capture drew them; $09 duplicates the missile $0A, $0B duplicates fan frame $0C, $9F (tiles $CC/$CE) has no known owner. Rendered from an assumed bank, so their look is not proven."}
- {"id": "gap.unspawned_types", "what": "Enemy behaviour types 3 ($AEE1), 27 ($B4F2) and 31 (RTS)", "status": "not catalogued as objects", "reason": "Never present in any slot type ($030C+i) of any record of any run, nor in the spawn logs (captures/*/spawns.txt); type 3 and 27 handlers reuse generic movement code, so no graphics of their own were found."}
- {"id": "gap.type30_stage7", "what": "Invisible stage-7 controller, type 30 ($B569)", "status": "partly understood", "reason": "When the ship is near it rewrites three attribute bytes (block 31: $27D6/$27DE/$27E6 = AF AA FA) and the terrain collision map ($06C2.. from $B612). It belongs to the green barrier of the stage-7 map, which is catalogued only as part of the stage map; its attribute change was not isolated in a capture."}
- {"id": "gap.series_names", "what": "Series names of gr.enemy.row_fighter (type 8), gr.enemy.spinner (types 13/14), gr.enemy.stage3_flyer (type 28), gr.enemy.stage5_roller (type 29)", "status": "series_name null", "reason": "Behaviour tracked, but no source ties these NES enemies to a series name. row_fighter behaves like the series Rugal (noted, not asserted). Jumper, Zub, Amoeba, Mother/Child are medium confidence (behaviour + stage match the series descriptions)."}
- {"id": "gap.not_pixel_verified_frames", "what": "Sprite frames without pixel verification", "status": "listed", "reason": "jumper frames 1/2 and ducker jump in bank 3, hatch ceiling red in bank 3, explosion_large frame from bank 3 (tiles identical to the verified bank-0/2 frames); sprite 0 (always behind the status bar, invisible by design); the three unused metasprites."}
- {"id": "gap.jp_bank1_tile", "what": "CHR bank 1 tile 496 (sprite tile $F0/$F1 top) differs US/JP", "status": "recorded in png/gr.variants.chr_differences.png", "reason": "Only metasprite $5E (Rush frame 0) uses tile $F1 and it is never drawn while bank 1 is active, so the difference is never displayed."}
- {"id": "gap.char_crops", "what": "Bounding boxes of char-drawn objects (Moai heads, volcanoes, blocks, nucleus, brain)", "status": "approximate boxes", "reason": "These objects are map data with no object table; boxes come from tool heuristics (Moai mouth patterns of $CA29, contiguous terrain runs, non-star bounding box) on the stitched maps. The full maps are in captures/stage_maps/."}
- {"id": "gap.boss_arena_map", "what": "Map columns scrolled during the boss phase ($85/$86)", "status": "not in the stitched maps", "reason": "Excluded to keep the stage-6 nucleus before its erase; the boss arena is empty starfield drawn with bank 2 and BG palettes 2/3 blanked (block 30). Frames are in usA records."}
- {"id": "gap.loop2_behaviour", "what": "Loop 2+ behaviour differences", "status": "not catalogued", "reason": "No new metasprite, tile or palette was drawn in loop 2 (usL2) or JP loops 2-6 (jpEnd); code reading $1A (e.g. $B951) changes behaviour only."}
- {"id": "gap.hidden_1up_condition", "what": "Hidden 1UP pick-up", "status": "captured with a RAM write", "reason": "The pick-up requires an even score digit ($07E5 bit 0); usC forced it even and moved the ship onto the invisible object (documented RAM writes). Natural pick-up not recorded."}
- {"id": "gap.crc_fail_screen", "what": "ROM check failure texts (KONAMI TEN / GRADIUS TEN)", "status": "decoded from blocks 36/38, not displayed", "reason": "The supplied ROMs pass both checks."}
- {"id": "gap.stage_skip_trigger", "what": "Natural stage-skip triggers", "status": "code-proven, one trigger seen", "reason": "In usB/usL2 the skip was triggered by the Moai counter $5F reaching 10 because the patched invincible ship rammed Moai mouths; the hatch and quick Big Core triggers were read from the code only."}
- {"id": "gap.audio", "what": "Music and sound effects", "status": "out of scope", "reason": "Graphics catalogue only (the project manifest already lists the NSF rips)."}

- {"id": "gap.stage_map_format", "what": "Stage map (metatile index sequences) and the static source of the background-drawn bosses", "reason": "Not decoded. Backgrounds are drawn by the metatile writer $E01C from WRAM $6800+ (4x4-tile metatiles, queue mode 5); the map stream that feeds it was not traced. Stage pictures are stitched from the captured nametables (captures/stageN_bg_stitched.png, captures/sN/nt.npz every 4 frames) and the WRAM after init is dumped (captures/sN/wram_after_init_*.bin). Boss tile matrices are the captured nametables; no RLE stream in PRG matches them (scan of 139 nametable RLE streams)."}
- {"id": "gap.bg_target_extent", "what": "Exact extent of the background-drawn destructible targets (type 8, S2 $1C/$2A/$2E, S4 $4A, S5 $51, S6 $56)", "reason": "They draw no sprite; the catalogue gives a 7x7-tile nametable window centred on the hit-box position just before destruction (confidence medium). The hit-box size table ($0507 & $0F -> $CF97) was not decoded into tile extents."}
- {"id": "gap.enemy_names", "what": "Names of all enemy, boss and scenery objects", "reason": "Descriptive labels chosen by looking (name_confidence low); series_name left null for every enemy/boss. The web pages that could give series names (tcrf.net/Salamander_(NES), gradius.fandom.com/wiki/Salamander_(Famicom)) were blocked (permission not granted). Identity (type byte, state table, sprite ids) is code-proven."}
- {"id": "gap.second_loop", "what": "Loops 2 and 3 ($31 = 1, 2)", "reason": "Only the start of loop 2 was captured (run ending). The sprite tables are indexed by $30 only, so graphics are the same; possible behaviour differences that read $31 (e.g. bank6 $AE6C copies $31 into an object variable) were not catalogued."}
- {"id": "gap.bonus_item", "what": "Item kind 3 (bonus score, $0529 = 3)", "reason": "Never spawned in the captures; invisible by code (sprite id 1 is empty, $DA68). Catalogued from code only (sfc.item.bonus, confidence medium)."}
- {"id": "gap.loose_option_pickup", "what": "Pick-up of a loose option by the other player", "reason": "Loose options ($80,X = 2) were captured (runs d1/d2) and are catalogued; the pick-up itself was not separately verified."}
- {"id": "gap.golem_materialisation_frames", "what": "Stage-1 boss CHR materialisation (43 BG tiles rewritten bit by bit, frames 13152-13855)", "reason": "Documented by code (bank6 $8E40, queue mode 4) and by the CHR images in captures/s1/chr.npz (one per changed frame); the intermediate tile states are not catalogued as separate frames."}
- {"id": "gap.title_font_letters", "what": "Letter-by-letter mapping of the title and HUD fonts", "reason": "Digits are code-proven ($EC + n); letters are only known through the strings that use them (sfc.font.title / sfc.font.hud)."}
- {"id": "gap.mode_switch_frames", "what": "OAM at mode switches", "reason": "59 frames in total are not reproduced by the composer model: 16 (run title) and 35 (run g1) around demo start/end where the title OAM writer and the composer overlap, 2 at game over -> continue (run d2) and 6 at ending -> loop 2 (run ending), all screen transitions with several skipped NMIs; also the first 4 frames of the run started from a savestate (ending) have no RAM history. Coverage lists them; no unknown sprite appears there."}
- {"id": "gap.player_blink_combinations", "what": "Invincibility-blink variants of every posture", "reason": "The blink forces the palette (attr modifier 5 for P1, 4 for P2, $C39A); not every posture x orientation x player combination happened while blinking (e.g. P2 horizontal $82 with attr 4). They are the same tiles with the palette forced, derivable from the frames given."}
- {"id": "gap.sound", "what": "Sound effects and music", "reason": "Out of scope of this graphics catalogue (sound ids are quoted in code_refs only)."}
